intro: An access file in Git manages the whole instance or one environment: there, every change to people, groups, grants, row filters and masks goes through the file.

scopes.title: Managed scopes
scopes.none: No access file manages any scope yet. Access is changed here and from the command line.

changes.title: Changes by hand since the last apply
changes.revert: The next apply reverts each change the file does not list.

plan.title: Plan and apply
plan.text: Plan and apply run from the command line or CI, with the file from Git. lakana access plan also tells whether Git holds a newer file than the one applied.
